title: mormolyca pudica
intro: Mormolyca pudica, commonly known as the "bashful orchid" or "Mexican orchid", is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of Mormolyca pudica include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
